title: 2026专硕英语 Unit 2 单词测试及校订

units.text:
原测试第1题
___ is the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the eye, including cataracts, glaucoma, and retinal diseases.

原文件答案：ophthalmology
校订后参考答案：ophthalmology
眼科学
眼科专业名；注意ophthalm-中的phth，不要漏写字母。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第2题
In emergency triage, patients with life-threatening conditions such as airway obstruction or massive hemorrhage must ___.

原文件答案：be given the first priority
校订后参考答案：be given the first priority / be given first priority
被优先考虑；被给予首要优先级
must后接be given构成被动语态；be given first priority也是可用搭配。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第3题
Rural communities often struggle to ___ specialized medical services and advanced diagnostic facilities.

原文件答案：get access to
校订后参考答案：get access to
获得使用或接触……的机会
access to services表示获得服务的机会；struggle to后填get access to，末尾to为介词。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第4题
Patients with a family history of diabetes and a sedentary lifestyle ___ developing cardiovascular complications.

原文件答案：have a higher risk of
校订后参考答案：have a higher risk of
有更高的……风险
复数主语patients用have；of后接名词或动名词，题中已有developing。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第5题
The evidence strongly supports early screening for breast cancer; ___ colorectal cancer in adults over 50.

原文件答案：the same goes for / come to the same conclusion
校订后参考答案：the same goes for
对……来说也是如此；同样适用于
主语the same+goes+for后接对象；不是“得出相同结论”。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第6题
As a general ___, she is often the first point of contact for patients presenting with undiagnosed symptoms in the community.

原文件答案：practitioner
校订后参考答案：practitioner
执业人员；（医学语境）医师
general practitioner为全科医师；a general后用单数名词。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第7题
Long-term consumption of ___ saturated fat and refined sugars is strongly associated with obesity, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.

原文件答案：a diet high in
校订后参考答案：a diet high in
富含……的饮食
high in修饰diet，后接所含成分；题干of后接整组a diet high in。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第8题
Without appropriate and timely intervention, chronic kidney disease may ___ to end-stage renal failure requiring dialysis or transplantation.

原文件答案：progress
校订后参考答案：progress
发展；进展
progress to意为进展为……；may后用原形。词义不必然表示病情改善。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

原测试第9题
Recent epidemiological studies show that the ___ of myopia among adolescents has risen sharply over the past two decades.

原文件答案：incidence
校订后参考答案：incidence
发病率；新发情况
强调一定人群和时间内的新发病例，与prevalence（现患情况/患病率）区分。原题未列研究出处，只作词义语境。
来源：26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

warning: 原资料题型为词库填空，用于回忆词义与用法；本期期末词汇题为选择题。校订处保留原答案供对照。
